meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-08-15 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c3d: level with previous night (55) · +1 vs 7-night avg (54)
en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: Lights out 23:59, up at 06:07 — 6h 01m asleep inside 6h 08m in bed. Bedtime came back under midnight after Thursday's 00:44, and that single change is worth 53 extra minutes and 8 score points: 76 against 68. It is still the second-shortest night of the window and 1h 14m under the 7h 15m average, so this is a partial repair rather than a finished one. Efficiency was the best of the seven nights — 98%, with only 7 minutes awake against a run of 25, 14, 21, 14, 8, 13. The stage mix inverted from the night before. Deep fell to 66 minutes from 100, which is 18% of the night and back inside the normal 20–25% band from the other side; across the window deep reads 93, 101, 61, 65, 101, 100, 66. REM recovered to 62 minutes from Thursday's 50, still well under the 85–147 the earlier nights delivered, and light sleep rebounded to 233 from 158. Read together: Thursday's body defended deep sleep at the cost of everything else, last night it stopped needing to and spread the time normally. The autonomics turned for the first time in four nights. HRV came in at 38, up 4 from 34 and 2 over the 36 seven-night average — the first above-average reading since Monday's 42, breaking the 33, 34, 34 soft run. RHR held at 55, unchanged and still at the top of the 53–55 band it has occupied all week, so that one has not resolved yet. Morning stress dropped to 22, the lowest of the window against 34, 35, 32, 32, 39, 33. Readiness 71, moderate — the trend is right, the absolute duration is not there yet. Yesterday was a genuine rest day (79 active kcal, max HR 110), which is most of why this morning reads better. One more night in bed by 23:00 would put duration back over seven hours and finish the job.

hr.c4d: +4 vs prethodna noć (34) · +2 vs prosjek 7 noći (36)
hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Gašenje svjetla u 23:59, ustajanje u 06:07 — 6h 01m sna unutar 6h 08m u krevetu. Lijeganje se vratilo ispod ponoći nakon četvrtkovih 00:44, a ta jedna promjena vrijedi 53 minute više sna i 8 bodova ocjene: 76 naspram 68. Ipak, ovo je i dalje druga najkraća noć u prozoru i 1h 14m ispod prosjeka od 7h 15m, pa je popravak djelomičan, a ne dovršen. Učinkovitost je bila najbolja od svih sedam noći — 98%, uz samo 7 minuta budnosti naspram niza 25, 14, 21, 14, 8, 13. Raspored faza obrnuo se u odnosu na prethodnu noć. Duboki san pao je na 66 minuta sa 100, što je 18% noći i povratak u normalni raspon 20–25% s druge strane; kroz prozor duboki san ide 93, 101, 61, 65, 101, 100, 66. REM se oporavio na 62 minute s četvrtkovih 50, još uvijek znatno ispod 85–147 iz ranijih noći, a lagani san skočio je na 233 sa 158. Zajedno: u četvrtak je tijelo branilo duboki san na štetu svega ostalog, sinoć to više nije trebalo pa je vrijeme rasporedilo normalno. Autonomika se prvi put u četiri noći okrenula. HRV je 38, četiri više od 34 i dva iznad sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 36 — prvo očitanje iznad prosjeka od ponedjeljkovih 42, čime je prekinut mlaki niz 33, 34, 34. RHR je ostao 55, nepromijenjen i i dalje na vrhu raspona 53–55 u kojem je cijeli tjedan, pa to još nije riješeno. Jutarnji stres pao je na 22, najniže u prozoru naspram 34, 35, 32, 32, 39, 33. Spremnost 71, umjerena — trend je dobar, apsolutno trajanje još nije. Jučer je bio pravi dan odmora (79 aktivnih kcal, maksimalni puls 110), i to je najveći dio razloga zašto je ovo jutro bolje. Još jedna noć s lijeganjem do 23:00 vratila bi trajanje preko sedam sati i dovršila posao.
